name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: TanStack Table drawn with the library's Table: the fluid hover row highlight plus resizable, draggable columns, sorting headers with an animated sort glyph, a ghost search field with a magnifying glass, an icon Columns menu that shows and hides columns, a checkbox selection column with a select-all dash, a row actions menu, pagination with arrow buttons, and skeleton loading rows that hand over cell by cell. A useDataTable hook wires the row models; every part reads and sets TanStack state, so each one is optional.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/data-table. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#data-table.
